universalAnswers.whatHappened: Six distinct developments changed oversight timetables, reporting duties, legislative status, reported security evidence and product access.
universalAnswers.plainLanguageIdentity: A selective Weekly organized by the operative verb rather than a forced common cause.
universalAnswers.evidenceBasis: Official government texts, company originals and an attributed security investigation.
universalAnswers.evidenceLimits: The article covers only SB1168 and AB1577 from California’s seven-law package. Security quantities and AI-role claims remain attributed to the investigator; no individual exposure or independently verified total is asserted. Provider capability and reliability comparisons are vendor claims and are not used as independent proof. H.R. 9340 was placed on the Senate legislative calendar September 24; no Senate passage or enactment is established.
universalAnswers.readerRelevance: Utility bills, local infrastructure, online shopping and familiar AI tools.
universalAnswers.affectedPeople: California residents and agencies, US ratepayers, online shoppers, and users of named Claude and OpenAI plans.
universalAnswers.changesNow: Deadlines and laws exist; the House proposal reached the Senate calendar but remains unenacted; investigation and product access retain stated scope.
universalAnswers.uncertainty: Later regulatory outcomes, Senate passage or federal enactment, individual exposure and rollout completion remain unresolved.
universalAnswers.readerAction: Ask what verb applies, who is covered and what later evidence is required.
universalAnswers.betterQuestion: What changed now, for whom, and what is the next decision or evidence?

legal-policy.legalStatus: California order effective; SB1168 and AB1577 enacted; H.R.9340 House-passed and placed on the Senate calendar but not enacted.
legal-policy.jurisdiction: California for the order and state laws; United States federal legislative process for H.R.9340.
legal-policy.parties: California agencies and covered facilities; Congress, state regulators and nonregulated utilities.
legal-policy.allegationVsFinding: Legal texts establish duties; promotional savings and protection claims are not treated as findings.
legal-policy.currentEffect: Planning, assessment and reporting duties exist; no universal kill switch, household saving or nationwide rate exists.
legal-policy.unresolvedQuestions: Recommendations, implementing proceedings, later reports, Senate passage, federal enactment and local rates.
legal-policy.nextMilestone: November16 recommendations, commission actions, 2029 assessment and any later Senate or enactment action.

safety-incident.incident: Investigators reported an AI-assisted retail card-skimming campaign on September 23 from an underlying interim report.
safety-incident.harm: Potential theft of payment-card details from online stores.
safety-incident.affectedPeople: Online retailers and shoppers may be affected, but no complete victim list or reader-specific exposure is established.
safety-incident.failedControl: The inspected evidence does not establish the initial compromise route or one specific failed shopper-facing safeguard.
safety-incident.responsibility: Responsibility and actor attribution remain unresolved; quantities and AI-role claims stay attributed to investigators.
safety-incident.confirmedUnknown: Publication dates and the report relationship are confirmed; campaign size, attribution, complete victims and any reader exposure remain unknown.
safety-incident.remediation: No affected-party remediation or consumer notice was established in the bound evidence.
safety-incident.recurrenceRisk: Skimming can recur while compromised stores remain active; an affected-party notice or independent update is needed for a specific reader consequence.

model-tool-release.productRange: Claude merged Cowork into ordinary Claude conversations; GPT-6 Sol and Luna are below Astra in OpenAI’s named model range.
model-tool-release.newCapabilities: Claude can route longer work from an ordinary conversation; OpenAI describes upgraded complex-work models with lower API prices than predecessors.
model-tool-release.bestFitTasks: Longer reports, documents, slides and complex Work or Codex tasks, subject to plan and rollout.
model-tool-release.notFor: No reader needs to switch when an existing tool already completes the task reliably; GPT-6 was not yet in Chat.
model-tool-release.nearestAlternatives: Existing Claude chat or Cowork and predecessor Sol or Luna models are the nearest practical alternatives.
model-tool-release.availability: Claude starts on Pro and Max over several weeks; GPT-6 Sol and Luna are in Work and Codex for named paid and organizational plans.
model-tool-release.freePaidBoundary: Claude Team and Free are to follow; OpenAI gives Free and Go users Luna in the desktop app.
model-tool-release.costBoundary: OpenAI reports lower API token prices, but this Weekly makes no subscriber-savings promise and tells ordinary users to check plan access first.
model-tool-release.limitations: Rollouts may not yet appear; plan and product-surface limits apply; vendor evaluations are not independent proof.
model-tool-release.technicalExampleProportionality: No benchmark score is used in the article; the product section focuses on recognizable tasks and access.
model-tool-release.vendorEvidenceBoundary: Capabilities, performance and reliability comparisons come from the providers; the Weekly treats them as vendor claims.

translation.newsVersionExact: This week brought real movement, but the verbs matter
translation.actualMeaningExact: All are real developments, but they do not create the same protection, evidence or access.
translation.mechanismExact: The California order leads to recommendations. The state laws lead to proceedings, reports and later public data. The House bill still needs enactment and local rate decisions. The security report needs corroboration or affected-party notices. Product releases still depend on plan, app and rollout.
translation.familiarExampleExact: For an electricity claim, look for the commission proceeding, local permit or approved rate.
